item.description: As part of Northern Marianas College’s facilities master plan, work is underway to modify and fortify an existing rock wall along Chalan Monsignor Guerrero, marking another step forward in campus improvements aimed at enhancing accessibility, safety, and connectivity across the NMC campus. item.description: CITADEL Pacific hosted a cocktail party at Crowne Plaza Resort Saipan’s Mari Bar on Thursday to celebrate two decades of business investments in the Marianas, including companies offering cutting-edge telecommunications services and high-quality fuel. item.description: JOINT Region Marianas Commander Rear Adm. item.title: Retiree warns on Saipan casino revival amid tourism slump
item.description: COMMONWEALTH Retirees Association President Juan I.
